es: Escribir un boletín de barrio con tres secciones, una voz cálida y concisa, y revisar un párrafo denso.

vocabulary.es: pulir, dar el último repaso a un texto

teaching.en: Each section of the newsletter has a short headline.
teaching.es: Cada sección del boletín tiene un titular corto.
teaching.explanationEs: Headline = título breve que dice de qué trata la sección.
teaching.audioText: Each section of the newsletter has a short headline.

teaching.en: A good newsletter speaks to every neighbour in a warm, clear voice.
teaching.es: Un buen boletín habla a cada vecino con una voz cálida y clara.
teaching.explanationEs: Mantén una sola voz en todo el texto: la del saludo, la de las secciones y la del cierre.
segments: A good newsletter speaks to every
neighbour in a warm, clear voice.
teaching.audioText: A good newsletter speaks to every neighbour in a warm, clear voice.

teaching.en: A dense paragraph is hard to read, so cut the padding and use active verbs.
teaching.es: Un párrafo denso es difícil de leer, así que quita el relleno y usa verbos activos.
teaching.explanationEs: Dense = demasiado cargado: muchas palabras para pocos datos.
segments: A dense paragraph is hard to read, so
cut the padding and use active verbs.
teaching.audioText: A dense paragraph is hard to read, so cut the padding and use active verbs.

teaching.en: Start with a warm greeting and end with a clear next step.
teaching.es: Empieza con un saludo cálido y termina con un siguiente paso claro.
teaching.explanationEs: Greeting = saludo inicial; el cierre dice qué debe hacer el lector.
segments: Start with a warm greeting and
end with a clear next step.
teaching.audioText: Start with a warm greeting and end with a clear next step.

teaching.en: Polish your text last: check the rhythm, the repetition and the headlines.
teaching.es: Pule tu texto al final: revisa el ritmo, la repetición y los titulares.
teaching.explanationEs: Polish = último repaso con el plan de edición de la clase anterior.
segments: Polish your text last: check the
rhythm, the repetition and the headlines.
teaching.audioText: Polish your text last: check the rhythm, the repetition and the headlines.

teaching.en: Bring a dish to share, and tell Sara about the event by Friday.
teaching.es: Trae un plato para compartir y avisa a Sara del evento antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Bring a dish to share: to + verbo expresa el propósito; by Friday = como máximo el viernes.
segments: Bring a dish to share, and tell
Sara about the event by Friday.
teaching.audioText: Bring a dish to share, and tell Sara about the event by Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es el titular de esta sección del boletín?

feedback.es: El titular es la parte corta que va primero y dice de qué trata la sección: Book swap.

hint.es: Busca la parte más corta, que va al principio.

origin.text: Book swap. Come and share your old books on Sunday at four. Bring two books.

choices.text: To whom it may concern: the following information is provided.
Hello, neighbours! Welcome to our street news.

feedback.es: Un saludo con Hello, neighbours y Welcome se dirige al lector con palabras amables; las otras versiones suenan frías.

hint.es: La voz cálida se dirige al lector con palabras amables.

feedback.es: El propósito se expresa con to + verbo base: to share.

hint.es: Después de la palabra que falta va un verbo base.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Únete a nosotros el domingo y trae un pastel.»

answer.text: Join us on Sunday and bring a cake

feedback.es: Dos órdenes breves unidas por and; el día lleva on: on Sunday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué incluye la última sección.

choices.text: A message of thanks to the neighbours.

feedback.es: El plan dice que la última sección da las gracias a los vecinos.

origin.audio: Here is the plan for the newsletter. The first section is the news. The second is the events. The last one says thank you to the neighbours.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada elemento del boletín con su función.

pairs.es: último repaso del ritmo y las repeticiones

feedback.es: Cada elemento tiene una función: el titular resume, el saludo marca la voz, el párrafo denso se corrige y pulir es el último repaso.

pairs.es: último repaso del ritmo y las repeticiones

prompt.es: Escribe el boletín de la calle: saludo cálido, tres secciones con titular y cierre.

answer.text:
Hello, neighbours!
Clean-up day: Come and help us clean the street on Saturday at 9:00. It is a good way to meet your neighbours. Bring gloves, and Carlos will bring the bags.
Market news: The market now opens on Wednesdays and Saturdays, from 8 to 12. It is a good place to buy fresh fruit, so come early and say hello to the sellers!
Street party: Join us on 20 May for a street party. There will be music and good food. Bring a dish to share, and tell Sara before Friday.
Thank you for making our street a friendly place. See you soon!
accepted:
Hello, neighbours!
Clean-up day: Come and help us clean the street on Saturday at 9:00. It is a good way to meet your neighbours. Bring gloves, and Carlos will bring the bags.
Market news: The market now opens on Wednesdays and Saturdays, from 8 to 12. It is a good place to buy fresh fruit, so come early and say hello to the sellers!
Street party: Join us on 20 May for a street party. There will be music and good food. Bring a dish to share, and tell Sara before Friday.
Thank you for making our street a friendly place. See you soon!

Hi, neighbours!
Clean-up day: Please join us on Saturday at 9:00 to clean the street. It is a good chance to meet your neighbours. Bring gloves, and Carlos will bring the bags.
Market news: From now on, the market opens on Wednesdays and Saturdays from 8 to 12. You can buy fresh fruit there, so come early and say hello to the sellers!
Street party: We are having a party on 20 May. There will be music and good food. Bring a dish to share and tell Sara by Friday.
Thanks for helping our street. See you soon!

feedback.es: Un boletín completo tiene saludo, tres secciones con titular, verbos activos, datos claros y un cierre que agradece o da el siguiente paso.

origin.text: Encargo: boletín de la calle Maple, con voz cálida y tres secciones. Datos: 1) Limpieza de la calle el sábado a las 9:00; traer guantes; Carlos pone las bolsas. 2) El mercado abre ahora los miércoles y los sábados, de 8 a 12. 3) Fiesta del barrio el 20 de mayo; traer un plato para compartir; avisar a Sara antes del viernes.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la versión más directa de este párrafo denso?

choices.text: If it rains on Saturday, the committee will move the party inside.
In the event of the rain on Saturday, the committee will make a decision to move the party to the inside.
If it rains on Saturday, it will be decided by the committee that the party will be moved inside.

feedback.es: La condición con if, el sujeto the committee y el verbo activo will move dicen todo con menos palabras; las otras versiones conservan el rodeo y la pasiva.

origin.text: In the event that it rains on Saturday, a decision will be made by the committee to move the party inside.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué voz usa el autor del aviso.

choices.text: Dry, because it only gives facts.
Ironic, because it praises a problem.
Warm, because it speaks directly to you.

feedback.es: El autor elogia un problema (el ascensor roto) con exageración: es la voz irónica, que dice lo contrario de lo que siente.

origin.audio: Dear neighbours, the lift is broken again. What a great start to the week. We love climbing five floors with the shopping.

prompt.es: Completa cada frase con la forma que falta.

feedback.es: Cada frase aplica una lección del bloque: relativa reducida (written), participio de presente (Feeling) y voz seca (dry).

sentences: The notice that was written by Sara is on the wall. = The notice ___ by Sara is on the wall.
Because he felt proud, Leo smiled. = ___ proud, Leo smiled.
The writer uses short sentences, so the voice is ___.

prompt.es: Revisa el párrafo denso: corta el relleno y usa un verbo directo.

answer.text: Because the hall was closed, Tom decided to hold the meeting in the yard.
accepted: Because the hall was closed, Tom decided to hold the meeting in the yard.
Since the hall was closed, Tom decided to hold the meeting in the yard now.
Tom decided to hold the meeting in the yard because the hall was closed.

feedback.es: El párrafo denso se arregla con because, un sujeto activo (Tom) y decided en lugar de a decision was made.

origin.text: Due to the fact that the hall was closed, a decision was made by Tom to hold the meeting in the yard at this point in time.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Un boletín cálido habla directamente a los vecinos.»

answer.text: A warm newsletter speaks directly to the neighbours

feedback.es: El sujeto a warm newsletter va antes del verbo speaks; directly to the neighbours cierra la frase.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión mejora el ritmo de esta sección?

choices.text: The book club meets on Tuesday, and it starts at seven, and it ends at eight, and it is for everyone.
The book club, Tuesday, seven, eight, everyone.
The book club meets on Tuesday, from seven to eight, and it is for everyone.

feedback.es: Reúne los datos en una sola frase fluida. Las otras versiones repiten and o quedan incompletas.

origin.text: The book club meets on Tuesday. It starts at seven. It ends at eight. It is for everyone.
